{{Top|leg}}
An '''ion piston''' was a component within the [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drives]] of [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud cars]]<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> and [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] such as the [[V-35 Courier/Legends|V-35 Courier]]. Ion pistons were susceptible to damage from small particles, such as sand.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> Along with other modifications, loosing the ion piston gave the [[Engine/Legends|engine ]]around an extra 400 revs per second, increasing a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car's]] speed and acceleration.<ref name="CRFG" />
